description_en: Describes the syntax and provides examples of the face restoration and enhancement feature (EnhanceFace)
description_zh: 本文介绍人脸修复增强EnhanceFace的语法及示例
name: EnhanceFace

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an OSS link in the Shanghai region. For local files or OSS links in other regions, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html.
Input limits:

- Image format: JPEG, JPG, BMP, or PNG.
- Image size: No more than 3 MB.
- Image resolution: Greater than 32 × 32 pixels and less than 2048 × 2048 pixels (the longest side must be less than or equal to 2047 pixels). The face must occupy at least 64 × 64 pixels.
- The URL cannot contain Chinese characters.
- The input image must contain a face.
- The input image should not contain more than 10 faces. Otherwise, only the 10 largest faces are processed.
- Faces in the input image should not have scratches or damage. The algorithm does not support this type of restoration.
- Faces in the input image should not be too clear or have excessively high resolution. Otherwise, reverse quality degradation may occur.

> If the image resolution exceeds the maximum limit, resize the image first. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/44688.html
parameters.help_zh:
图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html。
输入限制：

- 图像格式：JPEG、JPG、BMP、PNG。
- 图像大小：不超过3 MB。
- 图像分辨率：大于32×32像素，小于2048×2048像素（最长边小于等于2047像素），人脸占比不低于64×64像素。
- URL地址中不能包含中文字符。
- 输入图像需包含人脸。
- 输入图像中人脸数量不宜超过10个，否则只处理面积最大的前10个人脸。
- 输入图像中的人脸不宜存在划痕、破损等，算法暂不支持此类修复。
- 输入图像中的人脸质量不宜过于清晰或者分辨率过高，否则可能导致反向降质。

> 当图像分辨率超过最大限制时，请先将图片进行缩放，调整图片大小，具体请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/44688.html
parameters.name: image_url
